objective: Migrate the legacy EUC-KR fixed-width socket service to a reproducible JDK 21 Maven build with HikariCP while preserving protocol bytes and safe shutdown behavior.

tasks.title: Recover Maven dependencies and protocol baseline
acceptance_criteria: No dependency uses system scope or systemPath
Synthetic EUC-KR protocol byte tests exist before production charset behavior changes

tasks.title: Replace jdbcpool with HikariCP and explicit transaction boundaries
acceptance_criteria: The KCB update and insert operation commits or rolls back atomically
JDBC resources are closed with try-with-resources and data parameters are bound
tests: DAO transaction tests with fake or mock JDBC

tasks.title: Harden socket framing, concurrency, resource cleanup, and shutdown
acceptance_criteria: Short reads and EOF fail without returning padded data
Inbound sizes are bounded before allocation
Worker concurrency and shutdown waits are bounded
Shutdown closes Hikari only after socket work is drained

tasks.title: Complete JDK 21 and EUC-KR compatibility cleanup
acceptance_criteria: Protocol conversions use verified EUC-KR boundaries
CommonUtil range and empty-input defects are covered and fixed
Directly touched deprecated reflection and XML parsing defects are removed
JDK 21 test and package gates pass without production connections
